
---
title: "New York Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("ny_noaa", package = "p8105.datasets")

weather_data =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = as.numeric(prcp) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2010)

monthly_weather =
  weather_data |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    avg_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_prcp = mean(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(month_label = month.abb[month])

set.seed(8105)

temp_sample =
  weather_data |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax), !is.na(tmin)) |>
  slice_sample(n = 1500)
```

## Row {data-height=450}

### Average Monthly Temperature

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_weather,
  x = ~month_label
) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~avg_tmax,
    name = "Maximum temperature"
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~avg_tmin,
    name = "Minimum temperature"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h")
  )
```

### Average Daily Precipitation by Month

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_weather,
  x = ~month_label,
  y = ~avg_prcp,
  type = "bar"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average daily precipitation (mm)")
  )
```

## Row {data-height=450}

### Maximum vs. Minimum Temperature

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = temp_sample,
  x = ~tmin,
  y = ~tmax,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(opacity = 0.4)
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)")
  )
```

### About the Data

This dashboard explores weather patterns across New York State
using the NY NOAA dataset from the `p8105.datasets` package.

The analysis focuses on observations from 2005 to 2010.

The visualizations include:

- Monthly averages of maximum and minimum temperatures.
- Average reported daily precipitation by calendar month.
- The relationship between daily maximum and minimum temperatures.

Temperature and precipitation values were converted into
degrees Celsius and millimeters, respectively.

Missing observations were excluded from the relevant calculations.
The scatterplot uses a reproducible random sample of 1,500
complete temperature observations to improve performance.

Because reporting varies across weather stations, the monthly
averages describe available records rather than an evenly
weighted statewide climate estimate.
